rules.description: Prepare a risk-aware administrative quality review packet while retaining applicable human and regulatory controls.

provenance.note: Quality-system context only; no automated approval or compliance determination.

rules.description: Preserve investigation and data-integrity evidence for qualified review, including visible contradictions and out-of-specification context when supplied.

provenance.note: The scenario validates exported administrative evidence, not scientific adequacy.

rules.description: Validate exact bounded schemas, real dates, synthetic identifiers, exact duplicate collapse, and contradictory primary identifiers before business joins.
Select exactly one SOP version whose inclusive effective interval contains the deviation opened date.
Apply each selected-version requirement whose minimum severity is no greater than the deviation severity.

provenance.note: The checklist and severity ladder are fictional.

rules.description: Match eligible evidence by investigation and exact evidence type; future evidence is retained as an exception but cannot satisfy a requirement.

provenance.note: Metadata presence does not authenticate or assess the content.

rules.description: Calculate due dates from the opened date and classify open or completed investigations against invented calendar-day thresholds.

provenance.note: Thirty days and due-soon windows are examples, not regulatory limits.

rules.description: Do not draft a second follow-up reason when an eligible open task already exists for the same deviation and reason code.

provenance.note: No task is created or modified.

rules.description: Administrative completeness never approves an investigation, closes a deviation, dispositions product, or establishes regulatory compliance.

provenance.note: Every non-rejected row remains subject to qualified human review.

rules.description: Apply documented precedence and stable ordering, reconcile all deviation counts, and emit the complete result envelope.

steps.title: Inventory the synthetic exports
steps.procedure: Record as-of date, policy, and raw table counts without changing source data.

steps.title: Validate records and contradictions
steps.procedure: Validate the exact contract, collapse identical duplicates, and reject conflicting primary identifiers.

steps.title: Select the applicable SOP version
steps.procedure: Join each deviation opened date to exactly one effective SOP interval.

steps.title: Join investigation evidence
steps.procedure: Expand requirements by severity and join nonfuture evidence by investigation and evidence type.

steps.title: Evaluate administrative requirements
steps.procedure: Classify each requirement, due state, missing investigation, version mismatch, and late completion.

steps.title: Classify each deviation review
steps.procedure: Apply data-review, missing-investigation, sop-gap, administratively-complete precedence.

steps.title: Collect review exceptions
steps.procedure: Emit sorted evidence gaps and retain matching existing task references without sending or creating work.

steps.title: Prioritize the draft queue
steps.procedure: Order high, medium, then normal priority and break ties by deviation ID.

steps.title: Write the review-only packet
steps.procedure: Emit reviews, draft queue, totals, and explicit nonauthorization fields.
